name: Architecture patterns
description: Vendor-neutral patterns for agentic AI. They describe the idea, so they work on any cloud and any framework.

categories.name: Orchestration
categories.description: How work is split, sequenced, routed and delegated between model calls and agents: chains, routers, parallel fan-out, orchestrators, hand-offs.

categories.name: Reliability
categories.description: How the system catches and recovers from bad output or failure: evaluator loops, retries, fallbacks, checkpoints, idempotent steps.

categories.name: Context & Memory
categories.description: What the model sees and remembers: retrieval, context compaction, short- and long-term memory, shared state between agents.

categories.name: Tools & Integration
categories.description: How agents act on the outside world: tool design, MCP servers, sandboxes, connecting to enterprise systems and APIs.

categories.name: Safety & Governance
categories.description: Keeping agents within bounds: guardrails, least-privilege tools, human approval, audit trails, policy enforcement.

categories.name: Cost & Performance
categories.description: Making agents cheaper and faster: model routing by difficulty, caching, batching, budgets and limits.

categories.name: Evaluation
categories.description: Knowing whether the system works: eval sets, LLM-as-judge, regression testing, tracing and production monitoring.

name: Microsoft Azure
description: Reference architectures built from real Azure services. Each one implements one or more of the generic patterns above.

categories.name: AI Agents
categories.description: Hosting, orchestrating and connecting agents on Azure: Microsoft Foundry, Foundry Agent Service, Microsoft Agent Framework, multi-agent workflows.

categories.name: Data & Retrieval
categories.description: Grounding agents in enterprise data on Azure: Azure AI Search, Cosmos DB, Storage, Fabric and RAG pipelines.

categories.name: Integration & Events
categories.description: Connecting agents to systems and events on Azure: API Management, Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, Event Grid.

categories.name: Security & Governance
categories.description: Securing and governing AI workloads on Azure: Entra ID and managed identities, private networking, AI gateway policies, Content Safety, monitoring.
